subject: cn-info
title: CN.INFO.------AF.DY.
description: First of two diagrams on page 492 (MP(II)-10). The crossing diagrams how controlled-information structurally meets affinity-dynamics at the political-cultural reception scale: CN-INFO (controlled information) crossed with AF-DY (affinity dynamics — the partner-side's actual affinity working). CN-INFO sits on the left with the subject-arrow; (R)POST (the reality of postulation) rises from the main line at upper-center, ATT (attitude) branches from the POST line, AFI-2 (affinity insight—second degree) drops from the ATT line, and SOC-RT (social reality) branches from the AFI-2 line. AF-COMP (affinity compression) branches from the main line to the upper-right, with DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture's center) branching from the AF-COMP line and POL-P (political policies) from the DIS-C-CT line. AF-DY is the partner at the end of the main line at center-right. RIT-DY (ritual dynamics) branches from the main line down to the lower-left; INFO-DE (information degrees) branches from the RIT-DY line, TR from the INFO-DE line, and AFI (affinity insight) from the TR line.
